title.value: Multiple-model coding scheme for electrical signal compression
title.justification: The title of the paper is directly mentioned in the header of the provided text.
title.quote: Multiple-model coding scheme for electrical signal compression

analysis.description: This paper proposes a low-latency Multiple-Model Coding (MMC) approach for compressing sampled electrical signal waveforms under encoding rate constraints. The method uses window-based processes where multiple parametric waveform models compete to coarsely represent the signal within each window. Various residual compression techniques are evaluated to minimize reconstruction error, optimizing rate budget allocation. The approach enhances signal-to-noise ratio compared to existing methods for periodic and transient signals.

type.justification: The paper discusses simulation results comparing the proposed approach with state-of-the-art solutions, indicating it is empirical research.
type.quote: Simulation results show that the proposed MMC approach achieves a higher signal-to-noise ratio than state-of-the-art solutions on periodic and transients signal waveforms.
